source: enemy/group_<set>.rel, parsed STRUCTURALLY by tools/waves.py parse_assignment()
record: the per-room table is 20-byte records {roomCodePtr, listPtr, count, w3, w4}. The room codes are a 12-byte stride array at payload offset 0; the list is `count` 12-byte {template, weight, field3} records. NOF0 relocation offsets and pointer values are REGION-A relative while the NDR payload starts 0x10 further in, so 0x10 must come off a pointer before it indexes the payload.
w3_w4: the min/max wave-count pair A3 established; now carried per room rather than only in aggregate.
*** THIS REPLACES A CONTENT SEARCH, AND: the previous version located each room's list by SEARCHING the payload for a run matching the room's template and weight columns. That can land on a coincidentally identical run, and did: field3 was wrong in 11 of 252 rooms, including a spurious value of 16 for s01e_nr2 that does not exist. Template and weight were right in all 252, which is why the error went unnoticed — those were the columns being matched on.
validation: parsed set d reproduces the previously recorded template and weight columns for 252 of 252 rooms.

*** f1 CARRIES 23 EXTRA STAGE-8 ROOMS, N.the_undercount: a previous pass reported ten, s08e_ib0..ib9. Those were only the extras a regex demanding a LETTER in the variant position happened to match.
